text:
alex_k: Heads up — AcmePay reporting a spike of 503s hitting their Dedicated pool since ~07:10 PDT. They flagged a potential SLA breach (99.9%). Logs show queue depth climbing. Can runtime/infra owners triage? @mike_choi @sophie

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0452 — Dedicated 503 spikes. Pager duty notified.

mike_choi: I'm on it. Can repro against the dedicated perf test. Pulling logs and heap stats now.

sophie: Is this the same regression after the kernel swap last week? @alex_k do we have the customer traffic pattern?

alex_k: AcmePay shared a sample: many short chat completions, high concurrency (~250 rps). Tail latency climbs, then 503s. They tried fallback to hosted and that worked.

marta_cs: Looping CS in — AcmePay wants ETA + workaround. They can reroute to hosted but need step-by-step config. @mike_choi can you give an ETA?

mike_choi: Quick look: symptoms point to queue starvation on the preemption path when GPU memory pressure + continuous batching + quantized model. I have a small scheduler fix on a branch. If CR + canary go smoothly, estimate ~4h to hotfix + deploy.

priya_s: I can review, ping the PR link.

mike_choi: PR: https://git.redwood/infer/serving/compare/fix/preemption-queue — tiny change in scheduler logic. Tests pass locally. Example log check I ran:
```
kubectl logs -n serving --selector=pool=dedicated-us-west-2 -c runtime | grep "503" | tail -n 200
```

priya_s: I'll prioritize review. Heads-up: if we need a kernel rollback that will need eng-runtime + eng_infra coordination.

sophie: Plan to canary on one dedicated node first. @eng_infra can you carve out a canary host? If not, we can use staging pool.

eng_infra: We can carve a canary host in us-west-2 in ~30m. Will prepare AMI and attach to dedicated pool.

mike_choi: If the hotfix slips, workaround for AcmePay: reduce concurrency to 80 and enable prefix cache. That should reduce errors. Marta — can you send the exact curl snippet for the route config?

marta_cs: Sending now. snippet:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/routes/{route_id}/config -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"concurrency":80,"cache_prefix":true}'
Will include route_id in secure channel.

alex_k: Confirming ownership: mike — engineering lead for fix; priya — code review; sophie — canary/deploy lead; eng_infra — canary host; marta_cs — CS comms & workaround; I'll monitor and coordinate with customer.

priya_s: Reviewing PR now. Left one nit comment.

mike_choi: Nit fixed, pushed. PTAL.

priya_s: Approved. @eng-deploy-bot canary deploy please.

eng-deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for commit abc123 -> pool 'dedicated-us-west-2-canary'. CI: build 2026.3.17-1795.

oncall-bot: Update INC-2026-0452: canary deploy in progress. Current error rate for AcmePay down 60% on hosted fallback, dedicated pool still degrading.

alex_k: Thanks all. Marta will update AcmePay with workaround + ETA ~4h for hotfix; we'll escalate earlier if any blocker. I'll post a status update here in 2h. :thumbsup:
